content.a0:
✅ Free: Completely free to use
✅ Open Source: Code is completely public
content.a1:
Chrome Browser: Visit Chrome Web Store, search "ADHDGoFly", click "Add to Chrome"
Edge Browser: Visit Microsoft Edge Add-ons Store, search "ADHDGoFly", click "Get"
Manual Installation: Download plugin zip package, enable "Developer mode" in browser extension management page, select "Load unpacked extension"
content.q2: How to manually install the plugin?
content.a2:
1. Visit https://download.readgofly.online to download the zip package for your browser
2. Extract files: Mac double-click zip file to auto-extract, Windows right-click zip file and select "Extract"
3. Open browser extension management page: Chrome visit chrome://extensions/, Edge visit edge://extensions/
4. Enable "Developer mode" (Chrome) or "Developer mode" (Edge)
5. Click "Load unpacked" or "Load unpacked extension"
6. Select the entire extracted folder (don't select individual files within the folder)
content.q3: Can't see plugin icon after installation?
content.a3:
1. Check browser top-right corner extension icon (puzzle piece 🧩)
2. Find ADHDGoFly in extension list, click "Pin" icon (📌)
3. Ensure plugin is enabled (switch is in on position)
content.q4: Which browsers does the plugin support?
content.a4:
✅ Chrome 88+
✅ Microsoft Edge 88+
✅ Firefox (planned support)
✅ Safari (planned support)
❌ IE Browser (not supported)
content.a5:
Manual installation: Need to manually download updated versions
App store installation: Auto-updates, but may have 1-7 day delay due to official review
content.a6:
1. After installing plugin, visit any webpage
2. Plugin automatically detects page language and loads enabled dictionaries
3. Highlights page vocabulary based on set vocabulary categories and color schemes
4. Click plugin icon to adjust settings
5. Click close button to restore all highlighted words to original appearance
content.a7:
🇨🇳 Chinese - Default enabled
🇺🇸 English - Default enabled
🇪🇸 Spanish - Manual enable required
🇫🇷 French - Manual enable required
🇷🇺 Russian - Manual enable required
🇯🇵 Japanese - Manual enable required
More languages continuously being added...
content.a8:
1. Click plugin icon to open settings panel
2. Select "Color Settings" tab
3. Choose from preset color schemes (custom colors will be supported in future)
4. Save settings and apply to current page
content.q9: Can I add my own vocabulary?
content.a9:
1. In dictionary tab, expand "Custom Dictionary", click add button
2. Import custom dictionary JSON file
3. Can modify dictionary name, language, domain type (defaults to JSON file settings)
content.a10:
1. Visit custom dictionary tool: https://dictionary.readgofly.online/
2. Create and export JSON file, then import to plugin
3. After adding, enabled by default, can manage in corresponding language dictionary list
content.q11: Will the plugin affect webpage loading speed?
content.a11: Plugin uses asynchronous loading and intelligent caching technology, minimal impact on page loading speed (typically <50ms)
content.q12: Why don't some pages highlight partially?
content.a12:
Reason: Different website structures and content display logic
Solution: If it's a commonly used website, please contact us for feedback, we'll analyze page structure and adjust highlighting logic
Special cases: Login, payment pages involving password verification, if verification fails, please disable plugin highlighting first
content.q13: Why does it show "Connection failed, please retry"?
content.a13:
Common reasons:
1. Plugin update: Current page was opened before update - Solution: Refresh page then click plugin icon again
2. Special pages: Extension management pages etc. cannot be highlighted - Solution: Test on other regular websites
3. File corruption: Manually installed plugin files were accidentally deleted - Solution: Completely uninstall then reinstall plugin
content.q14: Plugin doesn't work properly on certain websites?
content.a14: If other websites can highlight but one specific website cannot, the website may prohibit plugin use. Please submit the problematic website to us, we'll analyze the specific reason
content.q15: Highlighting display is inaccurate or wrong?
content.a15:
1. This situation is common, after all there are many times when there are new vocabulary words, and our dictionary doesn't 100% include all vocabulary
2. Recommend checking question 9, consider using custom dictionary
content.a16:
1. Enable "Power saving mode" in settings
2. Reduce number of simultaneously loaded dictionaries
3. Clean useless vocabulary in custom dictionaries
4. Regularly clear plugin cache
content.q17: Does the plugin collect my personal information?
content.a17:
❌ Does not collect: Personal identity information, browsing history, page content
✅ Only collects with your permission: Anonymous usage statistics (like language preferences, feature usage frequency)
🔒 Promise: All data is completely anonymous, cannot be traced to individuals
📋 Details: View complete privacy policy for more information
content.a18:
1. Find "Privacy Settings" in plugin settings
2. Turn off "Anonymous usage statistics" switch
3. After turning off, no usage data will be collected
4. Does not affect normal plugin functionality
content.a19:
✅ Open source code, viewable on GitHub
✅ Passed browser store security review
✅ Does not access sensitive permissions
✅ Regular security updates, no malicious code
content.q20: Can it be used on mobile phones?
content.a20: Currently Edge mobile version can install some official extensions, ADHDGoFly plugin is not yet in the official support list. We are applying to join the official support list. If you use Edge, please rate us in the add-ons store, which helps us get support earlier
content.q21: What to do about conflicts with other plugins?
content.a21:
1. Identify conflicting plugins (usually other page modification plugins)
2. Adjust plugin priority in settings
3. Use "Compatibility mode" to reduce conflicts
4. If necessary, temporarily disable other plugins for testing
content.a22: Normally updates won't affect settings, future versions will support settings file export functionality
content.q23: Does it support hotkeys to enable/disable highlighting?
content.a23: Currently hotkey functionality is not supported, future versions will consider adding hotkey settings
content.q24: How to get technical support when encountering problems?
content.a24:
1. WeChat contact: zuoguyoupan2023
2. Feedback website: https://feedback.readgofly.online
3. Online documentation: View detailed usage instructions

descriptions.zh: Based on Jieba Chinese word segmentation dictionary, containing part-of-speech annotations for common vocabulary. Data sourced from public Chinese linguistic resources.
descriptions.en: Based on WordNet English dictionary, providing accurate part-of-speech classification and semantic relationships. WordNet is a large English lexical database developed by Princeton University.
descriptions.fr: Sourced from Morphalou French morphological dictionary, containing basic vocabulary part-of-speech information and morphological analysis.
descriptions.ru: Based on OpenCorpora open-source Russian corpus project, providing basic part-of-speech annotation functionality. Completely open and supports commercial use.
descriptions.es: Sourced from Apertium open-source machine translation platform's Spanish linguistic resources, supporting common vocabulary recognition.
descriptions.ja: Based on JMdict open-source Japanese multilingual dictionary, containing part-of-speech information for kana and kanji. Completely open and supports commercial use.
